mainEntity.name: Is the Sea Creatures matching game free to play?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, this sea-creature-themed memory game is completely free on Mindhack.in, with no download or account required.

mainEntity.name: How do I play the Sea Creatures match the cards game?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flip two cards at a time and try to find the two that show the same sea creature. Remembering where each card is as you go is the whole game.

mainEntity.name: Is this game good for kids and beginners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - it's a simple, low-pressure recall game that works well for kids and older adults alike, with no time pressure forcing you to rush.
